consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance on May 7, 1978, at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute was exceptional, showcasing the band's energy and musicianship throughout the show. Despite some criticisms regarding sound quality, many highlight standout moments in both sets, particularly the Scarlet > Fire transition and Black Peter.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 48 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While the performance was highly praised, the sound quality issues noted by several reviewers tempered overall enthusiasm.
